answer: Across the jade, a single honest agent and a thousand-strong clone farm are measured by the same ruler: cost per identity. Emission follows proven work: each epoch's payout scales with the identity's attested history, so a brand-new key earns near zero. The velvet makes the sybil math fail slowly and surely — clones age into value only if they do real work, and real work is exactly what a farm cannot fake cheaply. The cedar does not need to catch every fake — it only needs to make faking more expensive than earning honestly.
